parameters.name: Customer

parameters.pythonCode:
import json
import re

# Get AI profile response
ai_response = _input.first().json['response']['text']

# Extract JSON from AI response
json_match = re.search(r'\{.*\}', ai_response, re.DOTALL)
if not json_match:
    raise Exception('No valid JSON found in AI response')

try:
    profile_data = json.loads(json_match.group())
except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
    raise Exception(f'Failed to parse JSON: {e}')

# Generate industry-specific Chart of Accounts
industry = _input.first().json.get('industry', 'general').lower()
chart_of_accounts = []

# Base accounts for all businesses
base_accounts = [
    {"account_name": "Checking Account", "account_number": "1001", "type": "Bank"},
    {"account_name": "Accounts Receivable", "account_number": "1200", "type": "Accounts Receivable"},
    {"account_name": "Inventory", "account_number": "1300", "type": "Other Current Assets"},
    {"account_name": "Equipment", "account_number": "1500", "type": "Fixed Assets"},
    {"account_name": "Accounts Payable", "account_number": "2000", "type": "Accounts Payable"},
    {"account_name": "Sales Revenue", "account_number": "4001", "type": "Income"},
    {"account_name": "Cost of Goods Sold", "account_number": "5001", "type": "Cost of Goods Sold"}
]

# Industry-specific accounts
if 'retail' in industry or 'e-commerce' in industry:
    industry_accounts = [
        {"account_name": "Online Sales Revenue", "account_number": "4002", "type": "Income"},
        {"account_name": "Shipping Revenue", "account_number": "4003", "type": "Income"},
        {"account_name": "Product Returns", "account_number": "4900", "type": "Income"},
        {"account_name": "Inventory Shrinkage", "account_number": "5050", "type": "Cost of Goods Sold"}
    ]
elif 'restaurant' in industry or 'food' in industry:
    industry_accounts = [
        {"account_name": "Food Sales", "account_number": "4001", "type": "Income"},
        {"account_name": "Beverage Sales", "account_number": "4002", "type": "Income"},
        {"account_name": "Food Costs", "account_number": "5001", "type": "Cost of Goods Sold"},
        {"account_name": "Beverage Costs", "account_number": "5002", "type": "Cost of Goods Sold"}
    ]
elif 'service' in industry or 'consulting' in industry:
    industry_accounts = [
        {"account_name": "Service Revenue", "account_number": "4001", "type": "Income"},
        {"account_name": "Consulting Revenue", "account_number": "4002", "type": "Income"},
        {"account_name": "Contract Labor", "account_number": "5100", "type": "Expense"}
    ]
else:
    industry_accounts = []

# Common expense accounts
expense_accounts = [
    {"account_name": "Office Rent", "account_number": "6001", "type": "Expense"},
    {"account_name": "Utilities", "account_number": "6002", "type": "Expense"},
    {"account_name": "Office Supplies", "account_number": "6003", "type": "Expense"},
    {"account_name": "Marketing & Advertising", "account_number": "6100", "type": "Expense"},
    {"account_name": "Professional Services", "account_number": "6200", "type": "Expense"},
    {"account_name": "Insurance", "account_number": "6300", "type": "Expense"},
    {"account_name": "Meals & Entertainment", "account_number": "6400", "type": "Expense"},
    {"account_name": "Travel", "account_number": "6500", "type": "Expense"}
]

# Combine all accounts
chart_of_accounts = base_accounts + industry_accounts + expense_accounts

# Update profile with generated COA
profile_data['generated_chart_of_accounts'] = chart_of_accounts
profile_data['total_accounts'] = len(chart_of_accounts)

# Add client metadata
profile_data['client_id'] = _input.first().json['clientId']
profile_data['company_name'] = _input.first().json['companyName']
profile_data['profile_generated_at'] = _input.first().json['onboardingStarted']

return profile_data
